subject: prd/argus-unattended-drive
statement: If If a wake signal names a parked or closed problem, then the system shall resume at most to reconciliation: a parked problem wakes only for its answer append or human touch; a closed ledger is never reopened (post-close events travel by reverse citation)
intent: a journaled no-op touch, or nothing
fit_criterion: parked/closed wake fixtures: no drive act beyond the journaled touch; the closed ledger is byte-untouched
